43)rtsa gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis 'dod 'jo bzhugs/na mo gu ra bh+yaḥzab lam 'di la gzhol bar 'dod pas dben pa'i gnas su stan bde bar lus gan

tei:div.tei:p: rtsa gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis 'dod 'jo bzhugs/ na mo gu ra bh+yaḥ zab lam 'di la gzhol bar 'dod pas dben pa'i gnas su stan bde bar lus gnad bcos/ rlung ro bsal/ kun slong bcos/ bla mar gsol ba gdab/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ tshe mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras/ thar pa'i phan yon bshes gnyen bsten tshul rnams la blo legs par sbyangs nas/ skyabs sems ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bdag gzhan bla med don sgrub phyir// snying po'i lam la gzhol bar bgyi/ sgrib sbyong ni/ bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng*// bla ma rdor sems yab yum gyi/ sku la bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// sgo gsum dri ma dag par gyur/ yig brgya bzla/ rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim/ tshogs bsog ni/ sku gsum zhing khams rgya mtsho yi// dpal 'byor longs spyod ci mchis pa// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ dngos gzhi ni/ rang snang lhun grub 'og min zhing*// bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus// gzhi lus rdo rje phag mo'i sku// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// gri thod kha ṭ+wam̐ dur khrod chas// spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na 44) 'gying*// mdun mkhar 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong*// bla ma pad+ma badz+ra rtsal// dmar mthing dkar ba'i zhal gsum pa// phyag drug rdor dril ral gri dang*// bhan+dza bum pa kha ṭ+wam̐ 'dzin// lha lcam dmar mo ḍā ru dang*/ dung dmar 'dzin pas mnyam par sbyor// gar dgu'i nyams ldan 'bar ba'i chas// bud+dha thod phreng mi skyod pa// dbang chen rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal// me phreng thod pa'i dum bu can// rta mgrin lag na rdo rje sogs// rang rang bka' 'khor sprul par bcas// 'gags med sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sprin// gang 'dul mos pa'i dpal du shar// dbyings nas 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin spro// nyes bshags dge la bdag yi rang*// chos 'khor skor zhing bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ye shes sku// rtsa ba'i bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso// mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la// sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs// bdag rgyud smin grol mdzad du gsol/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba rdā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ bla ma'i sku yi gnas bzhi nas// 'od zer bdag gi gnas bzhir thim/ dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi dag 45) /sku bzhi thob pa'i snod du gyur/ slar tshogs zhing 'od du zhu/ rang dang dbyer med 'dres pa las// snying gar 'od kyi gur khyim dbus// dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa// phyag drug rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin// gnam zhal yum mchog kun bzang sbyor/ kha ṭ+wam̐ gas 'khyud bhan dmar stobs// dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs// zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi'i dpyi nas brdzis// ye shes me dpung klong du bzhugs// shar du badz+ra he ru ka /lho ru 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// nub tu rta mchog rol pa dang*// byang du badz+ra ki la ya// shar lhor bla med he ru ka /lho nub rig 'dzin rdo rje chos// nub byang dregs pa kun 'dul che// byang shar stobs ldan nag po ste// tshom bu dgu yi dkyil 'khor la// bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs rnams// nyi ma'i 'or zer bzhin du shar// sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs// ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal// sems dpa' sum brtsegs thugs ka ru// sngags phreng 'khor ba'i byin nus kyis// bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub// snang srid lha yi 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dha tu āḥ zhi bsnyen 46) dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ khro ba'i bzlas pa ci rigs par bsag mkha' 'gro'i gnas bzhir 'khor lo'i dbus// a yig so so'i 'dab ma bzhir// spyi bor badz+ra bā ra hi// mgrin par kro dhī kā li ste// snying gar ha ri ni sa dang*// lte bar a be sha ya gsal/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ra hi kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa a bā+e sha ya/ ci nus bzla thun mthar/

snod bcud 'od zhu rang la thim// rang yang mtha' nas dbus su yal// blo 'das chos sku'i rang zhal blta// rjes thob gnyug ma'i lha skur ldang*/ dge bsngo ni/ 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge rtsa kun// 'khor gsum yang dag chen por bsngo// mkha' khyab yid can rgya mtsho kun// he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog shis brjod ni/ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i sprin phung las// dge legs bye ba'i gru char 'bebs// phan bde'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa'i// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog ces pa'ang smon lam rgya mtsho'i bzhed ngor/ sangs gling bla ma dgongs 'dus/ nyang gter bka' brgyad bde 'dus dang*/ khros nag rnams kyi don bsdus lta bur/ rnying sngags dpal chen 'dus pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ zhus so// maṅga laṃ//
